title: AVATAR SIZING
content:
hi everyone ! i have a question regarding avatar sizing ,each time i try to manually put the measurement from my pattern making book or custom made of costumer the avatar look so weird or distorted

But hope to add in the future.For creating a custom avatar we recommend applying the closest ASTM size to your spec sheet and then adjust from there. Please also make sure that you are following best practices outlines on our Guide - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/833e879ecdde47b186024115b16b90c8

title: [Challenge] My Digital Closet Challenge Season3 #APT
content:
Hello, Creators!  
  
We are thrilled to introduce the **3rd My Digital Closet Challenge** on CONNECT, all thanks to your enthusiastic participation! 🔥🎉

  
This challenge is all about completing your stunning 3D outfit with CONNECT’s free dancing motion, turning it into an amazing lookbook animation.

* * *

For this round, we’re bringing the famous**APT Challenge** , inspired by Blackpink’s Rose and Bruno Mars!💃🕺

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d10e8ee2460f4706b9dcbb45217865b4/images/e1caa06bdafb470ea6534333a0bc12e5Thumbnail_Rose_375x500_low2.gif)

**Don’t miss this chance to show off your style and take on this exciting dance lookbook challenge with CONNECT!**  


Check out the participation details below.😊

* * *

After uploading to SNS, leave a comment on this post with the URL to your content. We’ll check the comments and feature your work on our Instagram!**😊🎉**

You can also **show off your challenge video or link in the CONNECT community!**  
Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!**🚀✨**

* * *

# **📌Challenge Details**  


  * Title : MyDigitalCloset

  * Concept: Open Theme

    * **There are no concept restrictions. Outfits with various concepts are welcome!**

    * Feel free to showcase any 3D outfits you’d like to introduce.

    * Previously released outfits are also welcome.



  * Participation Period: Ongoing

  * Participation Requirements

    * Use the motion file and avatars provided by CONNECT.

    * Collaboration is encouraged—multiple creators can work together to create a collaborative piece.

    * Upload your completed work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Tiktok using the relevant hashtags.

      * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT



  * **Participation Process**

1\. Download Motion and Avatar: Download the motion file and the avatar provided by CONNECT.

    * Motion

      * [**FV2_Dancing_APT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/a1595e432258425aaa9d4e19d0dd049d)

      * [**MV2_Dancing_APT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/d71bd2c6924e4818be9e60bbdad30474)

    * Avatar

      * [**Female**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/220711153359e22cfc41449280e4e7245de728)

      * [**Male**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/230420c9160bed61d945e6b5e3ebbe55fb03f6)

      * [**Mannequin**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2301100492be6460c740868ddf57abc64946e9)

2\. Creating Garment Animation: Apply the motion to each outfit project file and press the record button in animation mode to create the outfit animation.

    * TIP: Customize your avatar using ZACS!

3\. Rendering: Render the completed animation file.

    * We recommend an image size of 1080px * 1920px.

    * TIP : Use the [**CONNECT official Scene file**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2312DD1c848deff0094e4991a906bfc52dae0e)

4\. Editing: Edit the rendered video using an editing program.

    * You can refer to [**this video**](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_zgG9Qv37o/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==) for the editing process.

    * Feel free to use other programs if you prefer.

    * Background Music :****[**APT by Rose**](https://youtu.be/ekr2nIex040?si=IcN-y5xcN8OBLUf6)

5\. Upload to SNS: Upload your finished work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok.

    * Include the following hashtags

      * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT

6\. Complete Participation

    * Once uploaded to SNS, leave a comment on **this post** with your email address and the URL to your content.

      * Example : Participation Complete / [www.example.com](http://www.example.com)

    * You can also **show off your challenge video or link in the CONNECT community!**

      * Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!




* * *

  
Challenge Enquiry

1\. Direct message on [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/closet_connect_official/)  
2\. Comments on **this page**

title: Getting unreal meta human into CLO error
content:
Im having trouble getting my Metahuman in Unreal 5.5.3 into CLO using LiveSync. This is the error I get:  
Anyone knows how to fix this?

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/17249d97d69040a8a3c93c03c8470beb/images/08aca7b8dc3d47d7b96effe1d01398d1image_2025-02-28_130049229.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Revelesci,Thank you for sharing the issue with us. Could you do the following and see if the issue is resolved? 1. Navigate to 'Preview Scene Setting' panel on the right (it's next to 'Details' panel).2. Locate the 'Additional Meshes' section and expand the section by clicking the triangle in front of it.3. Locate the 'Skeletal Meshes' section and expand it. See if there is a corersponding MetaHuman Skeletal Mesh assigned to it. For example, something like 'f_med_unw_body_preview' should be there. Otherwise, you can simply select a desired body type and assign it yourself, but please note that the name of the Skeletal Mesh may differ depending on the body type of your MetaHuman.4. Make sure to have LiveSyncEditor launched, and send the animated MetaHuman body to CLO.Please let me know if this works. :)- Bryan
Reply 1: Hi Bryan, thankyou for the response! adding the additional meshes did work. However, a new problem occured. When I add any fabric material to a t shirt in CLO, and then try to sync in in Unreal, it crashes, giving the following error:LoginId:a6d37ec643c8cdf0d4cd13b83411ef40 EpicAccountId:28d268814b594deebb72977ca7b3d629 Assertion failed: MipView.GammaSpace == LayerData.SourceGammaSpace [File:D:\build++UE5\Sync\Engine\Source\Runtime\Engine\Private\TextureDerivedDataTask.cpp] [Line: 410] UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Engine UnrealEditor UnrealEditor UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core UnrealEditor_Core kernel32When i dont add any material, it works. Do you might have any idea how to fix this?
Reply 2: Yes, the crash issue occurs in CLO LiveSync 1.1.5 due to an incorrect way of processing material information when CLO material data is received in Unreal Engine. We have fixed it and released CLO LiveSync 1.1.6, so please download the latest CLO LiveSync. https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/17249d97d69040a8a3c93c03c8470beb
content_description: This web page aims to help users troubleshoot and resolve errors encountered when importing Metahuman characters from Unreal Engine 5.5.3 into CLO via LiveSync.

title: Clothes phasing in and out of avatar
content:
Hi there, I'm currently working on an external project for a client that requires me to create animations for traditional garments for a traditional dance animation. There's about 21 separate animations in total and most of them simulate without an issue with their respective animations, however for a handful of them I've encountered issues with the avatar where the garments start phasing and clipping into the avatar after the simulation ends. It's quite alarming and I am unsure how to fix this. The avatar and rigged animation was provided by my client through FBX format. I've already tried playing with increasing skin offset as well as subdividing the avatar's mesh but to no avail. Assistance would be really appreciated

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1MIVmB7uzRs

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/353d3028e31140f698e3239d2e3053cf/images/a8f586487b9c487985572200cfa80b35Screenshot%202025-02-28%20172055.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Please update to the latest patch (2024.2.328). I know it might sound silly, but have you tried rerecording the affected animations, do they turn out the same upon a second attempt?
Reply 1: My Clo program is up to date. I have tried rerecording and also restarting clo but doesn't seem to help unfortunately
Reply 2: Hi, the recording shows version 2024.2.284, this is why I suggested - could you share an example file with us here? https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/353d3028e31140f698e3239d2e3053cf
Reply 3: I am unable to share an example file as it only can save with only the garment animation, if the file is saved with the avatar fbx with its animation it will save as a corrupted file. the version shows an outdated one because it wasn't updated when i recorded it and since the issue persisted after i updated, i felt like i did not have to update it
Reply 4: Hi, could you share an original FBX then so tech support can run a test on their own? And do the animations that are working fine also save corrupted or only the ones with issues?
content_description: Seeking expert advice to resolve garment clipping and phasing issues in traditional dance animations using client-provided FBX avatars.
